references.text: In Matthew 8:28-34, when Jesus arrived in the region of the Gadarenes, he met two men possessed by demons who came out of the tombs. The demons cried out, acknowledged Jesus as the Son of God, and begged not to be tormented before the appointed time. This shows a similar recognition of Jesus by evil forces as seen in Mark 3:11.

In Luke 4:41, demons also came out of many people, crying out and saying, 'You are the Son of God!' But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ. This demonstrates the demons' recognition of Jesus as the Son of God, just as in Mark 3:11.
In Acts 19:15, an evil spirit addressed Jesus by saying, 'Jesus I know, and Paul I recognize,' showing a recognition of Jesus' authority over evil forces, parallel to what we see in Mark 3:11.
